verdicts.reason: A: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has dropped below the subhead, which breaks the reading order. The 20% off headline is undersized and the oversized shoe overpowers it. The centred Shop Sale button sits off the left-aligned text column, the legal line is tiny, and the upper-right circle area is empty. B: it has the same eyebrow-order mistake, and the left column is spaced unevenly, with large gaps between headline, subhead and eyebrow. The shoe is small and pushed to the edge of the circle. A big dead band fills the lower middle of the canvas. The CTA is cramped next to legal text too small to read at this size, so B feels more scattered and empty than A.
